tagline: General trading and export-import services connecting Indonesian food, agricultural, textile and MSME products to international markets.

story.title: General trading and export-import services connecting Indonesian food, agricultural, textile and MSME products to international markets.
story.body: CV Makmur Jaya Sentosa's own website describes a trading and export-import company established in March 2015, handling food, beverages, coffee, agricultural products, garments, textiles and MSME products, with particular focus on Middle Eastern markets. The site also describes consultation, documentation, logistics and customs-compliance support.
